# components/status

## Type Aliases

### StatusGlyph

```ts
type StatusGlyph = "dot" | "pill" | "bang" | StatusMarkGlyph;
```

The target silhouette. Bead glyphs (`dot`, `pill`, `bang`) morph between each
other; task glyphs (`ring` waiting, `arc` working, `check` finished, `cross`
refused) morph between each other.

---

### StatusMotion

```ts
type StatusMotion = "none" | "pulse" | "bounce";
```

Continuous activity, independent of the target silhouette.

### StatusSize
